item.text: I found the utility in the Drive app and its caller in the public bookmarks view. The function currently lives alongside UID lookup, and existing tests explicitly encode the old `0` fallback; I’m checking the caller’s expected `undefined`/`null` behavior before changing the contract.

The utility now filters persisted session keys to numeric suffixes, returns `null` when none qualify, and keeps the existing last active account preference. The bookmarks hook now skips resume when there is no valid local ID and continues listing bookmarks. I’ve updated the utility tests for the new contract and am running those plus the hook tests.
The targeted test command is still running without emitting output, so I’m checking whether it completes before switching to the repository’s direct Jest binary if needed.
